_comment: Leading Indicators Tracking Data - June 2026 refresh. The leading layer has deteriorated meaningfully since Nov 2025 (composite 5 -> 12): a broad AI-infrastructure equity selloff (Jun 5-6), distressed neocloud credit, an emergency power-curtailment order, and a hyper-concentrated funding blow-off-top.
_instructions: This file tracks leading indicators that predict AI infrastructure unwinding 1-3 quarters before lagging indicators. Update weekly for Tier 1 indicators.

metadata.description: Leading indicators for AI infrastructure unwinding - predicts Phase 1 entry before earnings reports confirm it. June 2026: sharpest deterioration since tracking began.
metadata._note: June 2026: composite 12/48 (was 5). Roughly half the layer flipped color or developed an A/B divergence. Highest-signal new developments: the Jun 5-6 correlated equity selloff and distressed AI-borrower credit (CoreWeave).

risk_rationale.summary: Composite Leading Score: 11/48 - still LOW (0-12) but at the very top of the band and approaching MODERATE, more than double the Nov 2025 reading of 5. The deterioration is concentrated and coherent rather than scattered: a real correlated equity drawdown finally arrived (Jun 5-6, Nasdaq -4.2% / ~$1.71T in a day), GPU rental pricing reversed from a 2025 collapse into a hard shortage, AI-borrower credit moved from manageable to distressed (CoreWeave ~600-770bps CDS), power stress escalated to emergency DOE curtailment authority, and funding hit a record in blow-off-top, hyper-concentrated form.
true_divergences: #6 Power Infrastructure Stress: Track A GREEN (capex flowing) != Track B RED (DOE emergency curtailment, FERC interconnection-halt request)
#12 Job Postings & Organizational Changes: Track A GREEN (AI hiring +92%) != Track B RED (layoffs running ahead of 2025; Oracle -20%)
risk_rationale.key_findings: The genuinely-strong, un-diverged greens are now only three (DC REIT occupancy, training-run cadence, NVIDIA partner flow) - and even those read as late-cycle 'hot' rather than early-cycle. Financial-market signals (correlation, funding, CDS) are where the deterioration clusters.
risk_rationale.validation_status: ELEVATED: leading layer transitioning from 'watchful' toward 'early-warning'. Lagging operating fundamentals (capex, revenue, chip orders) have NOT yet confirmed - the classic lead/lag divergence the dual-layer design exists to catch.

leading_indicators.name: GPU Secondary Market Pricing

track_b_assessment.llm_rationale: The 2025 price collapse has fully reversed into a hard shortage: H100 1-yr contract ~$2.35/hr (up ~40% from the Oct 2025 low), Blackwell capacity booked into Aug-Sep 2026, on-demand 'sold out across all GPU types'. Pricing power flipped back to suppliers - a regime change. Bullish for demand, but rising input costs plus looming 2027 capacity are a classic late-cycle setup.

leading_indicators.divergence_reason: Both tracks agree: hard shortage, prices rising. Flagged YELLOW for the regime change (reversal from 2025 collapse), not for weakness.

track_a_data.example: Claude Opus 4.5 cut to $5/$25 per M tokens (from $15/$75)

track_b_assessment.llm_rationale: Comparable-tier inference pricing fell roughly 10x from early 2025 to mid 2026; Epoch cites up to ~200x/yr on combined price + efficiency. Steep declines continue and remain growth-positive. Louder caveat now: pricing is partly VC/hyperscaler-subsidized and normalization is expected within 12-24 months.

Record-strong: Equinix Q1 2026 record gross bookings $378M (+35% YoY), AI = 60% of top deals, FY guide raised; Digital Realty +16% YoY, 90.1% occupancy, record interconnection bookings. No softening - the strongest unambiguously-green indicator, though it lags the equity stress.

track_a_data.recent_movements: Jun 5-6 2026: broad AI-infra selloff, Nasdaq -4.2% / ~$1.71T erased in a day, NVDA -6%, triggered by Broadcom guidance. Earlier in 2026 leadership had broadened (NVDA +12% YTD vs PHLX Semi +74%).
track_a_data.note: No clean June-2026 correlation coefficient is published; the single-day correlated crash is the key datapoint.

track_b_assessment.llm_rationale: Two-sided: through most of 2026 leadership broadened (lower correlation = healthier breadth), but the group still crashes together on bad news. The Jun 6 correlated drawdown shows the complex is one headline from re-correlating to the downside - the single most important new datapoint in this layer.

leading_indicators.name: AI Startup Funding Velocity & Valuations

major_labs_burn_multiples.openai: ~2x ($50B/yr compute vs ~$25B run-rate revenue); ~$14B 2026 loss projected
major_labs_burn_multiples.anthropic: compressing fast (~$47B run-rate revenue, nearing operating profit, spends ~4x less to train)
major_labs_burn_multiples.xai: ~6x+ (~$30B/yr capex pace vs ~$2-4B revenue); lost ~$6.4B in 2025

circular_flow_metrics.funding_atmosphere: Record but hyper-concentrated: OpenAI + Anthropic + xAI + Waymo absorbed ~65% of all Q1 2026 VC. Liquid for ~3 frontier labs; the long tail faces down-rounds ('disrupted or dead'). Concentration ratio rose from ~0.81 toward ~0.95 - labs now spend roughly a dollar of compute per dollar of hyperscaler AI revenue. IPO-exit rush (Cerebras) is a late-cycle liquidity signal.

track_b_assessment.llm_rationale: Velocity is at an all-time high but extraordinarily concentrated in a handful of mega-rounds with explicit bubble warnings in the coverage - blow-off-top behavior, not healthy breadth. The pivot to IPOs and a rising concentration ratio (~0.94) intensify the circular-flow fragility the thesis warns about.
track_b_assessment.llm_circular_flow_assessment: YELLOW->watch. AI labs spending ~$30B/quarter on compute now approximates 100% of cleanly-disclosed hyperscaler AI revenue. All major labs still burn multiples of revenue (xAI ~6x+). Sustainable only with continued FOMO funding; analysts now openly model OpenAI 'cash by mid-2027' scenarios.

leading_indicators.divergence_reason: Both tracks agree YELLOW: record absolute funding, but rising concentration (ratio ~0.94) and tail down-rounds signal fragility.

leading_indicators.name: Power Infrastructure Stress Signals

track_b_assessment.llm_rationale: Materially worse than Nov: a ~2,600 GW interconnection queue with 5+ year waits; PJM record capacity price $333.44/MW-day on a 6.6 GW shortfall; a DOE emergency order (May 2026) letting PJM curtail data centers; and PJM's market monitor asking FERC to halt new data-center connections. Power, not GPUs, is now the binding constraint on the next training-compute order of magnitude.

leading_indicators.divergence_reason: Methodology difference: Track A quantitative (capex flowing) = green; Track B qualitative (emergency curtailment, FERC halt request) = red. Emergency curtailment authority and the FERC request are new and material.

track_a_data.note: CoreWeave implied ~42% 5yr default probability; ~$9.7B maturities <12mo. Latest hard quotes are early-2026; exact June level not confirmed.

track_b_assessment.llm_rationale: Credit markets are pushing back hard on the most-levered AI borrowers even as equity 'pays for the story'. CoreWeave 5yr CDS in distressed territory (~600-770bps, ~42% implied default) is a different regime from Nov's 'up 20-30bps, manageable'. Oracle planning ~$65B of new debt. CoreWeave is the canary.

track_a_data.recent: GPT-5.4 (Mar 2026), Gemini 3.1 Pro (Feb 2026), Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6; xAI Colossus scaling 100k->200k+ GPUs

track_b_assessment.llm_rationale: Frontier training runs at ~1e26-1e27 FLOPs and ~$200-500M/run heading to $1-3B by 2027; release cadence at record velocity; labs still scaling. The binding constraint is shifting to power/substations, not chips.

leading_indicators.name: Inference Deployment Velocity

track_a_data.note: Inference spend to exceed training in 2026 (~$150B+); 72% of enterprises have >=1 AI deployment in production

track_b_assessment.llm_rationale: Deployment volume still expanding, but ROI realization is deteriorating: ~79% of orgs report adoption challenges (up double-digits YoY) and only ~29% see significant GenAI ROI (Deloitte 2026); MIT NANDA's 95%-of-pilots-fail finding still circulates. Volume up, monetization proof still weak.

leading_indicators.divergence_reason: Velocity green, but the ROI subtext worsened enough to mark the indicator YELLOW.

track_a_data.recent: GTC 2026: Google Cloud Vera Rubin NVL72 (H2 2026), Azure GB300 running Claude natively, sovereign-AI factories; NVDA put $30B into OpenAI's round

track_b_assessment.llm_rationale: Partnership flow steady-to-strong through GTC 2026. One nuance: reports of NVIDIA recalibrating direct OpenAI/Anthropic stakes ahead of their IPOs - strategic, not a demand signal.

leading_indicators.name: Analyst Estimate Revisions

track_a_data.note: NVDA consensus Buy, avg PT ~$275; CY2026 EPS growth est >20%

track_b_assessment.llm_rationale: Estimates still net-positive but bake in continued capex acceleration; analysts explicitly warn any capex deceleration triggers 'substantial downward revisions'. The Jun 6 Broadcom guide-down is the first crack and revisions are a lagging signal - pre-crash numbers don't reflect it yet.

leading_indicators.divergence_reason: Green on paper, but the Broadcom guidance miss is the first crack; marked YELLOW for rising downside revision risk.

leading_indicators.name: Job Postings & Organizational Changes

track_a_data.note: ~275k open AI roles; +92% AI-role hiring YoY, ~56% wage premium

track_b_assessment.llm_rationale: Tech layoffs ~81.7k in Q1 2026 (~half of all 2025) and >92k by late April; Amazon -16k in Q1 (-30k since Oct), Meta -8k, Oracle -30k (~20% of staff), Microsoft ~125k via 'voluntary' exits. A sharp bifurcation: AI talent scarce, everyone else cut - partly funded by the $725B capex shift. Oracle's 20% cut is notable given its AI-debt load.

leading_indicators.divergence_reason: Methodology difference: Track A quantitative (AI hiring +92%) = green; Track B qualitative (layoffs running ahead of 2025) = red.

leading_popover.description: Composite score from real-time market signals including GPU pricing, cloud costs, funding activity, and supply chain signals. Designed to predict Phase 1 entry 1-3 quarters ahead.

alignment_popover.description: Measures agreement between quantitative data-driven metrics and qualitative LLM research. Alignment indicates both approaches reach the same conclusions.

divergent_popover.description: Number of indicators where quantitative and qualitative approaches disagree. Divergence indicates data limitations or market complexity.
